analysis.title_zh: NVIDIA Cosmos3-H-Dreams：面向临床手术的交互式生成仿真
analysis.summary: 公告介绍 Cosmos3-H-Dreams，将交互式生成仿真推进到视觉与操作流程更复杂的临床手术场景，并称其体内影像表现为该团队迄今最具说服力。文中以操作抓钳、抓取并提起胆囊且场景实时响应为任务示例。此前首个 Cosmos-H-Dreams 版本基于 Cosmos-Predict2.5，面向 dVRK 桌面缝合。所给原文已截断，未提供新模型架构、量化验证或开放使用信息。[S1]
analysis.application: 建议：科研迁移可考虑将其作为手术机器人交互仿真、操作流程建模及仿真可靠性评估的候选研究方向，此为迁移设想，并非作者已验证结论。官方节选介绍了实时响应场景及体内影像表现，但未提供足以确认临床有效性、安全性或训练收益的实验结果。[S1]
evidence: Picture moving the Cadiere grasper, grasping the gallbladder, and lifting it, all within a generated surgical scene that responds in real time.

Today, we take the next step and introduce Cosmos3-H-Dreams, bringing interactive generative simulation to the visual and procedural complexity of clinical surgery with our most convincing in-body imagery to date.
Our first Cosmos-H-Dreams release, built on Cosmos-Predict2.5, brought interactive generative simulation to dVRK tabletop suturing, a foundational proving ground for surgical robotics.
